items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: But of course naturally the albums I made with Miles Davis was the most fun I had.

ctx.x: enthusiastic about having this kind of an interview because I didn't really feel that I wanted to be placed by anybody else or myself in a wax museum future now because I still have my/career in mind, you know.

So to speak of what I've done in the past and highlights, I have to know that there have been highlights somewhere but they don't seem to have been enough of them or a steady enough pursuit in my trade really to talk about it much. But of course naturally the albums I made with Miles Davis was the most fun I had. And the hardest work, but the most fun. And I had fun making my own albums too, I've enjoyed all the albums I've made really.
I think that there must be some joys that came though when it was clear to you that other people were recognizing what you were trying to do as something of superior quality.
